title: ProgressionJumpRun
description: Parkour plugin with persistent progression tracking — time runs, record personal bests, reward finishers with economy coins, and show leaderboards via holograms.
body:
# 🏃 ProgressionJumpRun

ProgressionJumpRun turns parkour into a proper game mode. Players start a run, race through the course, and land a time that's saved permanently. Personal bests, finish counts, and live leaderboards via holograms keep the competition alive even when you're offline.

Every course is placed with pressure plates — no complex region tools. Set the start plate, the finish plate, and you're done.

## Features

- **Timed runs** — millisecond-accurate timer from start plate to finish plate
- **Persistent stats** — personal best, total finishes, last run time saved per player per course
- **Economy rewards** — configurable coin payout on finish via ProgressionEconomy
- **Hologram leaderboards** — live top-10 display via ProgressionHolographicDisplays
- **Admin tools** — give plates, reset stats, reload config
- **Multiple courses** — unlimited named courses on a single server

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/pjr give plate <start\|finish>` | Get a start or finish plate |
| `/pjr stats <player> <course>` | View stats |
| `/pjr reset <player> <course>` | Reset player stats |
| `/pjr reload` | Reload config |

## Dependencies

Requires **ProgressionAPI**. Integrates with **ProgressionEconomy** and **ProgressionHolographicDisplays**.

---
Part of the **Rosewood Progression** ecosystem — built for RPG and MMO-style Paper servers.
